name: refined-whatsapp-web
description: Native-feeling layout, privacy, and shortcut controls for WhatsApp Web.

scripts.package: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/unpacked && cp -R manifest.json _locales icons popup src dist/unpacked/ && find dist/unpacked -name '.DS_Store' -delete && cd dist/unpacked && zip -qrX ../refined-whatsapp-web-$npm_package_version.zip .
